The dominant stall is MIO scoreboard (62.5% of cycles) caused by 11.9-way shared memory bank conflicts arising from the current BLOCK_M=64, BLOCK_N=64, BLOCK_K=32 tile shape. Reducing tile sizes (e.g., BLOCK_M=32, BLOCK_N=32) will lower register pressure, increase occupancy, and reduce per-tile shared memory usage. Adding num_stages>1 enables software pipelining to hide memory latency. @triton.autotune will find the optimal combination across these axes.
